name: Susie Wolff
profile: Scottish former racing driver (Formula Renault, DTM for Mercedes-Benz, Williams F1 test driver 2012-15). Team Principal and shareholder of Venturi Racing in Formula E from 2018, CEO from 2021, leaving in 2022. Since 2023 runs F1 Academy, the all-female series. Shares Rich List wealth with husband Toto Wolff.
interesting_fact: At the 2014 British Grand Prix she became the first woman to take part in a Formula 1 race weekend in 22 years.
deep_cut_fact: Born Suzanne Stoddart in Oban, where her parents ran a motorcycle dealership; she started karting at eight and was British Woman Kart Racing Driver of the Year in 1996-99. She left an international business degree at Edinburgh to turn pro, and the university later made her an Honorary Fellow (2013).
notes: Official site has a Contact page; also books speaking through agencies. Founded Dare To Be Different (2016) to promote women in motorsport.

name: Wu Zhenling
current_role: Executive director / vice chairman, Tian Shan Development (Holding) Ltd (HK:2118); company in liquidation since 2023
profile: Co-founder of Shijiazhuang-based Tian Shan Development (Holding), the Hebei property developer listed in Hong Kong (2118); Wu Zhen Shan is chairman. A May 2023 HKEX announcement put the company in liquidation with trading suspended, and still named him an executive director. Also linked to Hebei Tianshan Shuzhi Electronic Technology.
interesting_fact: Before Tian Shan, he founded a Shijiazhuang Hi-Tech Zone construction & engineering company in 1995. Tian Shan Development (Holding) was founded in 2005.
deep_cut_fact: He has been vice chairman of the Project Construction Quality Branch of the Hebei Construction Association (since July 2011).
notes: Hurun lists the company as 'Tianshan'. Tian Shan Development is in liquidation (HKEX, May 2023: https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2023/0505/2023050501389.pdf). Wealth figure is likely stale. No published contact found.
